_comment: Pterodactyl egg for web-fps — a single Node process that serves the built client and the WebSocket game server on one port. Import via Admin > Nests > Import Egg. The installer clones the repo, builds the client, and prunes to runtime deps. The server reads SERVER_PORT (injected by Wings).
name: Web FPS (1v1 Arena)
author: admin@mawcks.net
description: Browser 1v1 PvP arena shooter — carve a map from a top-down editor, then fight Counter-Strike-style one-life rounds in it. One process serves the built client and the WebSocket room server on a single port; put a TLS reverse proxy in front (forwarding WebSocket upgrades) for wss://.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates
GIT_REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/Mawcks/web_fps.git}"
GIT_BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ -d .git ]; then
  echo "Updating existing checkout (${GIT_BRANCH})..."
  git remote set-url origin "${GIT_REPO}"
  git fetch --depth 1 origin "${GIT_BRANCH}"
  git reset --hard "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}"
else
  echo "Cloning ${GIT_REPO} (${GIT_BRANCH})..."
  rm -rf /tmp/wf
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/wf
  cp -a /tmp/wf/. /mnt/server/
  rm -rf /tmp/wf
fi
echo "Installing dependencies..."
npm install --no-audit --no-fund
echo "Building client..."
npm run build
echo "Pruning to runtime dependencies..."
npm prune --omit=dev
echo "web-fps install complete"

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Source repository the installer clones. Defaults to the public web_fps repo; point it at a fork to deploy your own.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Branch (or tag) to deploy. Reinstall the server to pull the latest of this branch.

variables.name: Tile budget
variables.description: Carve tiles each player may open in the shared editor.

variables.name: Round wins to take the match
variables.description: Round wins needed to win the 1v1 match (default 5).

variables.name: Rounds before side swap
variables.description: Total rounds played before the two players swap spawn sides (default 4).

variables.name: Freeze time (ms)
variables.description: Frozen buy/look-around time at the start of each round, in milliseconds.

variables.name: Round-end gap (ms)
variables.description: Pause between the end of a round and the start of the next, in milliseconds.

variables.name: Match-end gap (ms)
variables.description: Pause after a match ends before the room returns to the lobby, in milliseconds.
